text_block_list.name: Player A
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! They're... gonna get our flag! I-it's
over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated screams echo throughout
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Two teams are vying for victory in capture
the flag. Unfortunately, it's
not looking so
good for one team...

text_block_list.name: Player A
text_block_list.text:
Dang it, no matter how many times we try,
we just can't get past their
defense! Like,
they've got no weak points!

text_block_list.name: Player B
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, speaking of defense—look at ours!
We're... doomed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Come on, team... Don't give up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, we've still got a chance!
Defenders, listen up! Dig your
cleats in
and make sure they don't push us any
further back—I know
you have it in you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'll need three people confident in
their strength to follow me.
We can't hold
out forever, so we'll just have to bring the
fight to
them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita, you're planning on charging through
them head-on, right? If
anyone can do it,
it's you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I got this! I've been carrying portable
shrines way heavier than
me since I was a
kid! So check this out, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone—chaaarge! Today will be our victory! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A miracle unfolds before my eyes. She breaks through the opposing defense before grabbing the flag and scoring. Now that's a comeback!

text_block_list.name: Player B
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Kitasan! Or should I say—our
clutch captain?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks! ♪ But I couldn't have done
it myself. We won because
of everyone's
hard work! Let's keep this up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a trainer, I can't help but be entranced
by her cheerful expression
and that
determined look in her eyes—not to
mention her natural
knack for leadership.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you're a trainer, right? You've
got your eye on her,
don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, Kitasan Black—or Kita, for short! I
can't wait to see where
she'll go. Who
would've thought she'd grow up to be such
a leader?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, so you know who I am. Makes sense. You'd have to live under a rock to not recognize the Invincible Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I wonder what kind of racer Kita
will be. She used to always
say she wanted
to be just like me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah! Teiooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Did you see me back there?! Did you see
how I ran?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm still nowhere near your level, but I'm
giving it my all every day so I
can make my
debut!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm, that's the spirit! If you enter the
tryouts, I'm sure you'll find a
trainer in no
time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, speaking of, you must be a trainer.
Nice to meet you—I'm
Kitasan Black!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She deeply bows to me in greeting. Seems
like she's got good
manners, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, Teio! I'm entering an upcoming
scrimmage, and my
childhood bestie Dia
will be there too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We're running in different races, but we
promised each other we'd
both win. So,
um... would you want to come watch?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you betcha! But if I'm coming out to
watch, then you better
show me some
great running, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious myself, I make a mental note to go
watch her at that
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the day of the scrimmage arrives.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can win—I've got this. All right, as long as
I run with the pack, I'll
eventually overtake
them...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? Huh?! Nobody's... falling
behind?! You're kidding
me—they're
speeding up?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black frantically tries to catch up
to the runners in front. In the
end... she
finishes in third place.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, nice going out there. We totally
thought you had it in the
bag, though...
Are you feeling under the weather?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? I really thought that was my race,
too... Ah! Dia's race is about
to start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race features Kitasan Black's
childhood friend, Satono
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So this... is the pace of Tracen Academy.
It's about what we
expected. Wait for it,
wait for it... Almost...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now! This is my chance! Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond bursts forward. Right
before the finish line, she pulls
slightly
ahead and claims victory.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wh-what was that, Dia?! Um, I mean, I'm happy that you won and all... But wasn't that different from how you usually run?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I totally flubbed up my own running, so I
have to know—what's your
secret?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well... the races at Tracen Academy are
far removed from the
amateur scene. I
came in knowing that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All I did was utilize what I learned from my family and coach. This is what've they've been preparing me for, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We've all been working towards one
dream—that one day, I'll win a
G1 race.
And I don't plan on letting their efforts go
to waste.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is our family's dream. Everyone's been
waiting for this day—and
for all the races
still to come—since long before I was even
born.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why I feel more relaxed now.
I took my first step—made
my first ripple
in this vast ocean that I must traverse.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I always assumed... that we were the
same...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(We were inseparable—playing together,
competing with each other,
supporting
one another... But...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I was wrong. Whenever it got dark and we
said our goodbyes... Dia
was still putting in
the work to improve herself afterwards.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Dia didn't just get lucky today. She and
her family worked hard to
get here. That's
why she won—and I...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Kitasan Black gritting her teeth in
frustration as she gazes at the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet beneath her frustration, I can
sense her determination and
strength of
will.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I... didn't notice... at all. I didn't
understand anything...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But... but... it's only uphill from here! Sure,
I might've lost today, but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? Hey, aren't you that trainer from
the other day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some strange reason—one that I can't
even explain myself—I feel
like I have to
say this now, or never.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaaaaat?!
